key.nusmp.system_floor: Show the floor report (theme and mechanics)
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.gr: The baseline deepslate hold of falling stone, heavy weights and lightning rods.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.bl: Nether brick and crimson wood: blood, bone and torture, with the Crimson Reliquary at its heart.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sp: End stone, purpur and crying obsidian: folded space, mirrors and doors that lead nowhere.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fl: Blackstone, magma and lava forges: heat, sparks and molten channels.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fr: Packed ice, snow and spruce: a freezing hold where the cold slows everything.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ve: Mossy stone, azalea and cherry: an overgrown ruin the forest has taken back.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.st: Oxidised copper, tuff and lightning rods: a vault that crackles with the weather.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sh: Polished blackstone, sculk and soul lanterns: halls of shadow that hide what stalks them.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.as: Quartz, calcite, prismarine and gold: a cold observatory of stars.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ra: White quartz, smooth stone and gold with light everywhere, the air thick with Light Rukh.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ab: Dark organic rock, sculk, moss and netherrack growing through deepslate, lit by soul fire.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fe: The Feywild: giant glowing flowers and mushrooms, will-o'-wisps, tricks and illusions.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.dw: A dwarven hold of dressed stone, copper and iron, anvils, lava behind glass and a vault of kings.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.cr: A giant amethyst geode of calcite and basalt, budding crystals, crystal bridges and a resonance puzzle.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.su: The temple of a forgotten good god, flooded to the knees: prismarine, sea lanterns and tidal gates.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ho: A great cathedral: nave and pews, stained glass, a bell tower, a crypt and a reliquary.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ce: The marble terraces, golden gates and colonnades of a heavenly court.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sk: A cloud giant's castle in the sky: white stone, wind and long drops.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.mo: A monks' retreat of timber and paper: a dojo, a bell and a hall of prayer wheels.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.cu: A library of forbidden knowledge: endless shelves, reading halls, chained tomes and a scriptorium.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ne: A city of the dead: sandstone catacombs, bone pillars, mausoleums and bone bridges over an abyss.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.va: A grey gothic keep with crimson trim: a dining hall, a desecrated chapel, coffin crypts and mirrors that show nothing.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.ha: A haunted house: a nursery with a rocking horse, a ballroom of dancing ghosts, long corridors and sudden big rooms.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.fu: The Underdark: forests of huge mushrooms, glowing spores, obsidian drow halls and a dark lake.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.in: The Nine Hells as a factory: red nether brick, chains, cages, lava crucibles, anvils and a contract hall.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.dr: A sunken crypt of dark prismarine and mossy stone, barnacles, kelp-grown sarcophagi, tide gates and air pockets.
message.nusmp.mega.system.floor.theme.sp: A spider queen's warren: black stone and tuff veiled in cobweb, silk bridges, egg sacs and the queen's lair.
